Monica — thanks for the clear note. We're on it. Quick summary from production & ops:

Resin-printed pins production lead time: 3 days if we expedite; rush fee $210 + $0.95/unit.

3) Packing list & insurance: attached packing_list_partial_ship.xlsx and vendor_quote_TypeAndStitch_12122026.pdf. We carry $10k transit insurance by default; we can increase to $50k for an additional premium (quote on the doc).

The remaining enamel pins (600) will be produced as resin-printed and ground-shipped to SF office. Total estimated cost (expedite + partial substitution): $3,150 (line items in attached quote).

If that works, reply "Approve: Type & Stitch quote" and we'll start packing and issue an invoice for immediate payment. We can also sign a carrier release and share the airway bill once shipped.
